products.title: Valeo Marine Collagen+ Mango Flavour
products.body_html:
Delicious mango-flavoured Japanese Marine Collagen Peptides (Type I) in a daily beauty drink format. 7 g collagen per serving to support your beauty-from-within routine. 208 g pack with 26 servings.

Valeo Marine Collagen+ Mango is a premium Japanese marine collagen peptide (Type I) supplement designed to support your daily beauty routine from within.

Each serving delivers 7 g (7,000 mg) of hydrolysed marine collagen peptides, sourced from fish and designed for easy mixing into your daily beverages.

Infused with a bright Alphonso mango flavour, this collagen drink transforms your daily supplement routine into something enjoyable and easy to maintain — because consistency is what matters most.

The low molecular weight hydrolysed collagen is designed for easy dissolution in water, juices, smoothies, or recipes, making it simple to include in your lifestyle every day.

With regular use, marine collagen is commonly included in wellness routines that support skin appearance, hair strength, nail health, and connective tissue support over time.


INGREDIENTS

Japanese Marine Collagen Peptides (Type I), Maltodextrin, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Nature-Identical Alphonso Mango Flavouring, Sucralose (INS 955), Permitted Synthetic Colour (INS 110)

Contains: Fish-derived ingredients

Usage: Take 1 scoop daily (7 g) mixed into 150 ml of cold water or any beverage of your choice.

Can be added to:

  • Water
  • Smoothies
  • Juices
  • Coffee or tea
  • Breakfast bowls or recipes

Stir well for 20–30 seconds until fully dissolved. Consume once daily as part of your routine.

FAQs:

1. Does it taste like mango?

Yes, it has a smooth Alphonso mango flavour designed to make your daily collagen routine enjoyable and easy to maintain.

2. How much collagen is in each serving?

Each serving contains 7 g (7,000 mg) of hydrolysed Japanese marine collagen peptides.

3. What type of collagen is used?

It contains Type I marine collagen peptides, commonly used in beauty and wellness routines.

4. How should I take it?

Mix one scoop (7 g) into 150 ml of water or your preferred beverage once daily.

5. When should I take it?

Any time of day — consistency is more important than timing.

6. Is it suitable for everyone?

Not suitable for individuals with fish allergies. Consult a healthcare professional if pregnant, nursing, or on medication.

7. Does it contain sugar?

It contains no added sugar and is sweetened with sucralose for taste.



Why Valeo Marine Collagen+ Mango Flavour?

  • 7 g Japanese Marine Collagen Peptides (Type I) per serving
  • Delicious Alphonso Mango Flavour for daily enjoyment
  • Designed to support consistent daily collagen routine
  • Hydrolysed peptides for easy mixing in hot or cold liquids
  • 208 g pack providing 26 servings
  • Easily blends into water, smoothies, coffee, or recipes
  • Premium marine collagen sourced from fish

products.title: Plum 1% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid Foaming Face Wash - 110ml
products.body_html:
Plum 1% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid Foaming Face Wash is a specialized cleanser formulated to help combat acne, unclog pores, and control excess oil while maintaining skin comfort. Featuring encapsulated Salicylic Acid technology, the formula provides a gradual release of the active ingredient to help cleanse pores effectively and support clearer-looking skin with reduced irritation potential.

Synonym Names

  • Facial Cleanser
  • Acne Face Wash
  • Foaming Cleanser
  • Skin Wash
  • Oil-Control Face Wash
  • Pore Cleansing Face Wash
  • Salicylic Acid Cleanser

Type of Face Wash

  • Foaming Face Wash
  • Acne-Control Cleanser
  • Salicylic Acid Face Wash
  • Oil-Control Face Wash
  • Pore-Cleansing Face Wash

Key Ingredients

  • 1% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid – Helps exfoliate pores, remove excess oil, and support acne-prone skin.
  • Mild Cleansing Agents – Effectively remove dirt, oil, and impurities.
  • Hydrating Ingredients – Help maintain moisture balance.
  • Skin Conditioning Agents – Support soft and comfortable skin after cleansing.
  • Soothing Components – Help reduce the feeling of dryness associated with acne care products.

Benefits

  • Helps control excess oil production.
  • Assists in unclogging pores.
  • Supports clearer-looking skin.
  • Helps reduce the occurrence of acne and blemishes.
  • Removes dirt, impurities, and excess sebum.
  • Helps improve skin texture.
  • Refreshes and cleanses without excessive stripping.
  • Suitable for daily acne-care routines.

How Does It Work

The face wash uses encapsulated Salicylic Acid technology, which gradually releases the active ingredient onto the skin. Salicylic Acid penetrates into pores to help dissolve excess oil, dead skin cells, and debris that may contribute to breakouts. The foaming cleanser removes impurities while helping maintain a balanced and refreshed complexion.

Why Choose This Product

  • Contains 1% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid.
  • Designed specifically for acne-prone and oily skin.
  • Foaming formula for effective cleansing.
  • Helps unclog pores and control oil.
  • Gentle release technology may reduce irritation.
  • Suitable for regular use.
  • Cruelty-free and vegan-friendly.
  • Supports a clearer-looking complexion.

Suitable For

  • Oily Skin
  • Acne-Prone Skin
  • Combination Skin
  • Congested Skin
  • Teenagers and Adults
  • Men and Women

Individuals with very sensitive skin should perform a patch test before use.

How To Use

  1. Wet your face with lukewarm water.
  2. Dispense an adequate amount of face wash into your palm.
  3. Gently massage onto damp skin using circular motions.
  4. Focus on areas prone to acne and excess oil.
  5. Avoid the eye area.
  6. Rinse thoroughly with water.
  7. Pat dry and follow with moisturizer.

Morning Routine

Face Wash → Toner (Optional) → Serum → Moisturizer → Sunscreen

Evening Routine

Face Wash → Treatment Products → Moisturizer

Recommended Frequency

  • Start with once daily use if new to Salicylic Acid.
  • Increase to twice daily if tolerated.
  • Suitable for regular morning and evening use depending on skin tolerance.

Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid direct contact with eyes.
  • Perform a patch test before first use.
  • Discontinue use if excessive irritation occurs.
  • Do not apply on broken or damaged skin.
  • Use sunscreen daily, as exfoliating ingredients may increase sun sensitivity.
  • Avoid overusing multiple exfoliating products simultaneously.

Side Effects

Some individuals may experience:

  • Mild dryness
  • Temporary redness
  • Slight peeling
  • Mild tingling sensation
  • Skin sensitivity during initial use

These effects are often temporary as the skin adjusts. If irritation persists, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

Storage Instructions

  • Store in a cool, dry place.
  • Keep away from direct sunlight.
  • Close the container tightly after use.
  • Avoid exposure to excessive heat and humidity.

Additional Information

  • Cruelty-Free
  • Vegan-Friendly
  • Paraben-Free
  • Encapsulated Active Technology
  • Suitable for Acne-Care Routines
  • Foaming Cleanser Format
  • Designed for Regular Use
  • Travel-Friendly Packaging

Certifications

  • Manufactured in GMP-Compliant Facilities
  • Quality and Safety Tested
  • Dermatologically Evaluated Ingredients
  • Produced Following Standard Cosmetic Manufacturing Practices

Refer to the product packaging for the most up-to-date certification information.

FAQs

What is encapsulated Salicylic Acid?

Encapsulated Salicylic Acid is designed to release gradually onto the skin, helping provide acne-care benefits while potentially reducing irritation.

Is this face wash suitable for acne-prone skin?

Yes, it is specifically formulated for oily and acne-prone skin types.

Can I use it every day?

Yes, but beginners may wish to start with once-daily use and increase frequency as tolerated.

Does it help unclog pores?

Yes, Salicylic Acid is known for helping remove excess oil and debris from pores.

Should I use moisturizer after washing?

Yes, applying a moisturizer helps maintain hydration and support the skin barrier.

Can I use this with other acne treatments?

Yes, but use caution when combining multiple active ingredients to avoid excessive dryness or irritation.

Do I need sunscreen while using this face wash?

Yes, daily sunscreen use is recommended when using Salicylic Acid-based products.

Disclaimer

The content is purely informative and educational in nature and should not be construed as medical advice. Please use the content only in consultation with an appropriate certified medical or healthcare professional. Individual results may vary depending on skin type, skincare routine, and environmental factors. Always read the product packaging and ingredient list before use. If irritation, redness, or allergic reactions occur, discontinue use and consult a qualified dermatologist.

products.title: Plum Coconut Milk & Peptides Strength & Shine Shampoo | 250ml | Full Size

Infused with Coconut Milk and Peptides, the formula removes dirt, excess oil, and product buildup without excessively drying the hair, leaving it smooth, manageable, and healthy-looking.

The shampoo gently removes dirt, excess sebum, sweat, and styling product buildup from the scalp and hair. Coconut Milk helps replenish moisture and improve softness, while Peptides support stronger and healthier-looking hair. Regular use helps maintain a clean scalp and smooth, shiny hair.
